metadata.title: The coerciveness and generalised Monge-Ampère equations
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove the equivalence between coerciveness and the existence of a solution to the generalised Monge-Ampère equations for right-Noetherian polynomials satisfying several assumptions. This includes the case of strictly interlacing polynomials. In particular, we have generalised Chu-Lee's result to supercritical but not hypercritical LYZ equations.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 广义 Monge–Ampère 的强制性与可解性
analysis.workSummary: 在满足指定假设的 right-Noetherian 多项式类中证明强制性与广义 Monge–Ampère 方程解存在等价，包含严格交错多项式。
analysis.breakthrough: 将 Chu–Lee 结果推广至超临界但非超高临界 LYZ 范围。
analysis.limitations: 等价性带多项式结构与其他假设，不是所有广义 Monge–Ampère 方程的无条件判别。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露以自行分解的命题为起点，要求 ChatGPT 6 Astra 给出反例或特殊情形证明，反复讨论后据反馈修改命题并大幅核改证明；另用于语法纠正。
